messages:
deploy-bot: Starting rollout: release v2.18.0 -> prod (change window: 2026-03-20 22:00 UTC). Canary = 5%. Route: /v1/embed -> embed-service:v2.4.1. Release notes: https://releases.redwood.ai/v/2.18.0 :rocket:

maya: I'll stand watch on SLO dashboard (/dash/slo/embeds). Ping me if p95 > 400ms or 5xx rate rises.

sre-runbook-bot: ALERT (automated): SLO burn detected for embed-service. 5m p95 = 780ms (baseline 220ms). 5xx spike observed (502).

alex: seeing same in eu-west canary nodes. 502s correlate with longer prefixes and async-kernel path.

pradeep: pause the rollout and pin traffic to previous variant. Do not roll infra. Maya — can you flip canary to 0% via deploy-bot? :rotating_light:

maya: Pausing rollout now. deploy-bot -> update: canary traffic set to 0% (confirmed). Telemetry: p95 dropping to ~260ms within 2 mins.

alex: good catch. Suggest quick rollback to v2.17.0 for embed-service and open an investigation branch. Also add extra tracing on kernel selection.

pradeep: agree — rollback only on model binary, keep config and autoscaler. Schedule follow-up: postmortem + hold next change window until kernel patch validated.

deploy-bot: Rollback executed: embed-service -> v2.17.0. Traffic shifted, canary=0, prod pinned to v2.17.0. Release notes updated with rollback marker. :white_check_mark:

maya: collecting traces and flamegraphs now, attaching to TICKET-3421. Action: add smoke test reproducing long-prefix workload (100k tokens) to preflight.

sre-runbook-bot: Runbook note appended: if p95 > 500ms and 5xx_rate > 0.5% during change window -> pause rollout, pin traffic, and notify oncall + eng-releases.

alex: added trace hooks and a reproducible test to the branch. Will re-run canary after kernel patch. :thumbsup:

pradeep: closing the loop — update the release notes with rollback reason and tag stakeholders. We'll reconvene in the morning for root cause triage.
